decisions.reason: The evening day-patient program builds on the established psychiatric offer, has its own page and required staff and regulatory investment, so management will keep it and attribute any slow uptake to the start-up phase.
The carpentry workshop uses invested equipment, is presented on its own page and serves the participation mission, so management will persist despite modest sales.
The senior living counseling service is shown on the home page, is central to the eldercare direction and costs little, so withdrawal is very unlikely.
The retail shop has low visibility and real operating costs, but it sells workshop output and supports inclusion goals, so sunk investment and the need to justify it favor continuing.
The meal delivery service launched only in 2024 and fits the eldercare direction, so management will treat weak early results as start-up effects despite its limited visibility.
